description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dhutugemunu, Dehiwala D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520802 (24/1039)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registrations and declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner names, property extents, locations, and title classifications, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
